title: 第625章 炸鱼大王重出江湖第624章 战败破风城诸老祖
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “弟兄们，最终时刻已经到来了！”
高台上的杜龙扫视了一圈，缓缓开口道，声音洪亮，夹杂着灵力增幅，清晰传入每一个人耳中。
“尔等可知，我为何将帮派取名为‘狂风’？”
台下一片寂静，只要是个智力正常的修士，都不会在头领说话的时候真上去回答问题。
“两千年前，破风城外千里，有一处灵矿，名为‘风吟’。”
杜龙一边说着，一边抬手指向远方。
“那座矿脉品质不高，产出的灵石只够低阶修士所用。”
“但对我们这些散修来说，已是一处足以安身立命的根基。”
“那时我杜龙不过是个金丹修士，带着一帮兄弟在矿中挖矿修炼。”
“日子虽比不上在宗门世家里当差，却也乐得和平安稳。”
顿了顿，杜龙的声音陡然转冷，用阴狠的目光看向柱子上捆着的各家族元婴。
“可破风城的世家大族，容不下我们。”
“兰家，梓家，常家……这些高高在上的世家，联合发布了一道驱逐令。”
“说风吟之地方圆百里的地脉，都归他们破风城管辖，我们在那里采矿，是侵占世家产业！！”
杜龙转过身，目光如刀。
“我与几位兄弟前去破风城申辩，愿缴纳灵石，换取采矿之权。”
“可这些老东西，连门都没让我们进！！！”
“你们世家的狗奴才，将我等从城中一路打至城外，让我等毫无尊严！”
台下不少修士都低下了头，眼眶泛红。
“我们本以为，忍一忍就过去了。”
“灵矿没了，换个地方便是。”
说着，杜龙的拳头缓缓握紧，丝丝鲜血从指缝中滴出。
“可我们错了！”
“不过十日，破风城各家联军忽的杀到风吟矿，指责我们擅采世家灵脉，当以盗矿罪论处！！”
“我那一百二十七名兄弟，各个都是老实本分的散修，却被世家修士像宰鸡杀猪般屠戮殆尽”
说到此处，杜龙的声音都开始颤抖，无穷恨意伴随着声音涌出，令最前排的修士都不由胆颤。
“我杜龙的亲弟弟，杜岩，那年才是五十七岁，不过刚刚筑基，本有着大好前程，却被兰家的金丹长老一剑穿心！”
“弟弟他临死前还在喊让我快跑……”
“…那一战，风吟矿一百二十八人，只有我杜龙一人活了下来，是我的兄弟们用命……替我杀出了一条血路！”
“我逃出之后，辗转万里，历尽凶险，终于有了今日的修为。”
“而这两千年来，我无一日忘记过那个夜晚，无一日忘记过我弟弟临死前的眼睛……”
“每天晚上我都在想，在想弟弟死去的时候是不是很害怕…如果我的实力再厉害一点，或许他……”
content_en:
"Brothers, the final moment has arrived!"
Du Long, who was on the high platform, glanced around and spoke slowly, his voice loud and clear, mixed with the increase in spiritual power, clearly reaching everyone's ears.
"Do you know why I named my gang 'The Wind'?"
There was silence in the audience. No monk with normal intelligence would actually go up and answer questions when the leader was speaking.
"Two thousand years ago, thousands of miles outside Pofeng City, there was a spiritual mine called 'Wind Yin'."
As Du Long spoke, he raised his hand and pointed into the distance.
"The quality of that mine is not high, and the spiritual stones it produces are only enough for low-level monks."
"But for us casual cultivators, it is a foundation that is enough to settle down and live."
"At that time, I, Du Long, was just a golden elixir monk, leading a group of brothers to mine and practice in the mines."
"Although life is not as good as working as a servant in a sect family, I am still happy and peaceful."
After a pause, Du Long's voice suddenly turned cold, and he looked at the Nascent Souls of each family tied to the pillars with a sinister look.
"But the aristocratic families in Pofeng City cannot tolerate us."
"The Lan family, the Zi family, the Chang family...these aristocratic families jointly issued an expulsion order."
"They say that the land veins with a radius of hundreds of miles in the Wind Singing Land are all under the jurisdiction of Po Feng City. If we mine there, we are encroaching on the family's property!!"
Du Long turned around, his eyes like daggers.
"A few brothers and I went to Broken Wind City to plead our case and were willing to pay spiritual stones in exchange for the right to mine."
"But these old guys didn't even let us in!!!"
"The dog slaves of your noble family beat us all the way from the city to the outside of the city, leaving us with no dignity!"
Many monks in the audience lowered their heads, their eyes red.
"We thought we could just endure it and get over it."
"The spiritual mine is gone, just find another place."
As he spoke, Du Long slowly clenched his fists, and traces of blood dripped from his fingers.
"But we were wrong!"
"On the tenth day, the coalition forces from Pofeng City suddenly came to Fengyin Mine and accused us of exploiting the spiritual veins of the famous families. We should be punished for stealing the mine!!"
"My one hundred and twenty-seven brothers were all honest and dedicated casual cultivators, but they were slaughtered like chickens and pigs by monks from aristocratic families."
At this point, Du Long's voice began to tremble, and endless hatred surged out along with his voice, making the monks in the front row tremble with fear.
"My brother Du Long, Du Yan, was only fifty-seven years old at that time. He had just established his foundation and had a great future, but he was stabbed through the heart by the elder Jindan of the Lan family!"
"My brother was still shouting at me to run before he died..."
"...In that battle, out of the 128 people in Fengyin Mine, only I, Du Long, survived. It was my brothers who... sacrificed their lives to fight a bloody path for me!"
"After I escaped, I traveled thousands of miles and experienced many dangers, and finally achieved the level of cultivation I have today."
"And in the past two thousand years, I have never forgotten that night, and I have never forgotten my brother's eyes before he died..."
"Every night I wonder if I was scared when I thought about my brother's death... If I were stronger, maybe he..."
